articles.summary: COPENHAGEN, Denmark, April 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ascendis Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ASND) today announced it plans to report first quarter 2026 financial results and provide a business update on Thursday, May 7, 2026, before the open of the U.S. financial markets.
